slice: B3 active provider wire unknown-field policy
B3 provider binding, intent, terminal, and receipt invariant validation

change.summary: Harden the active provider wire contracts with strict unknown-field rejection and explicit pre-adapter validation without changing evidence storage projections.
change.unknown_field_policy: ProviderRequestBinding, ProviderInvocationIntent, ProviderTerminal, and ProviderInvocationReceipt reject unknown fields at active v1 decode boundaries.
validation: text identifiers and terminal reason codes are non-empty, bounded, and NUL-free
all SHA-256 fields are canonical lowercase digests
ephemeral input and witness digests are present together or absent together
request binding, attempt, and receipt IDs are recomputed and identity-fenced
terminal response and partial-response digests are validated before wire encoding
change.canonical_encoding: canonical_wire_bytes validates first and then emits the active provider JSON wire bytes; it is intentionally distinct from the hepta-evidence sorted projection and does not alter stored payload digests.
change.compatibility: Legacy payloads that omit the optional ephemeral input and witness fields remain decodable; historical evidence receipts are not rewritten. Unknown future fields are rejected rather than silently projected.

remaining_gaps: B3 process-bound SecretRef refresh/rotation and invalid-grant adapter remain unimplemented in this slice
Provider-owned signed StatusByEffectKey/direct ACK provenance and external trust-root remain release-gated
Physical provider exactly-once, crash-after-send, and power-loss evidence remain outstanding
H4 durable writer/outbox and B5 authbusd recovery remain separate implementation work
This receipt makes no production, efficacy, promotion, or external authority claim
